title: World Panorama
description: Load a real world instead of a static image for the panorama
body:
# World Panorama

See and interact with a living world, right in your game's title screen.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3wAg-CaekE0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

You can configure this mod to either use a world you've previously saved as the panorama, or generate a brand new one every time you open the title screen.

This mod depends on Malilib (+ API) to be configured.

Beautiful icon by kr1v.
